01/12/2024
Claim opened following a side impact at a controlled intersection. The insured driver is named on the policy, and the
claimant was identified at the secne as a passenger in the vehicle that was struck. Police report and witness
sttaements place the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision.
01/14/2024
Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office. Photographs
taken at the scene confirm several visible details of the impact. No independent witnesses have been located beyond
the parties and responding officers.
01/20/2024
Vehicle damage was reviewed and is mostly consistent with the described side ipmact and direction of force. No
earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior records, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start of
coverage.
03/02/2024
Reported wrist fracture was reviewed against the mechanism of this crash and is plausible. Medical records show a
prior minor strain to the same area several years ago, which healed fully and has been noted for completeness.
04/05/2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with imaging, immobilization, and therapy, and the claimant's symptoms and
treatment intensity tapered as recovery progressed. The claimant has given the same account of the collision in every
conversation to date.
04/25/2024
File remains open pedning receipt of final treatment summary and the attorney's itemized documentation. Reserve
reviewed and no change recommended at this time.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
